subject: [PATCH v4 15/19] selftests/mm: check that one khugepaged pass collapses one window

2026-08-15.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm suite, called khugepaged_sync_check. The test checks that one pass of the khugepaged daemon collapses exactly one window, and attributes the collapse attempt to the correct source pages. The test prepares an aligned window, records its source PFNs from the pagemap, runs a full pass of khugepaged, and then verifies that the window was collapsed with exactly one collapse attempt attributed to it. This patch also adds four small helpers in vm_util for reading the trace buffer.
